notes.title: Congratulations to the winners of the SudoKube contest!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41518892/652ff88e929e29e8c35f2211542f0e64a9b75f30.png[/img]

[h1]We'd like to congratulate the first players to complete our unique souls-like 4x4 SudoKube![/h1]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41518892/1098dc8562aeb46aa23e63bfd11d6b2bcc4de978.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for putting so much time into our game. It fills our hearts to know that we developed something that motivated people to dedicate so many hours to complete it. Thank you for all the support and feedback provided during this mission!

As promised, everyone who has met all of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1770230/view/3314098953823917439]contest[/url] prerequisites has already received keys for all of our games. They will also receive a key for every game we release in the future.
This might not seem like much today, but I hope it's worth a lot someday :)

[i]If you're one of the top 10 and haven't completed the other prerequisites yet, there's still time ;)[/i]

notes.content:

notes.title: Sudokube is Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41518892/652ff88e929e29e8c35f2211542f0e64a9b75f30.png[/img]

The moment has come for us to launch Sudokube!

It was an incredible experience, full of challenges and complexities that we did not expect to face! Believe me when I say that taking on the challenge of creating Sudokus in a cube shape is much harder than it appears (at least for us).

But after many sleepless nights and almost burnout, we are finally confident in publishing it!

Thanks to the amazing community that tested the game exhaustively and tried to break it in unimaginable ways HAHA. Your feedback and bug reports made the game much better than it would have been! You are amazing!

This won't win GOTY, but it has already won several gray hairs on the heads of 2 brothers trying to make cool games!

[b]Support us by giving it a chance![/b]

Be sure to give us feedback and tell us what you think of the game. It helps us a lot to know that we are heading in the right direction of our career!


Big hug from Brazil!

notes.title: Bug fixes and more
notes.content:
Helo everyone,

This little game has been an incredible journey! Very good feedback from players!
I focused on adjusting the most recurring requests. See what's changed:

[olist]
[*] Double "=" no longer crash the game;
[*] The following situations no longer occurred:
[list]
[*]1 * N
[*]N * 1
[*] 1 ^ N
[*] N ^ 1
[/list]
[/olist]

Please, if you find any recurrence of these problems, let me know through the forum ;)

Also, keep sending us your suggestions on how to make it even better!

notes.title: 3000 mathematicians on the Leaderboard already!
notes.content:
We didn't expect that in just 4 days we would have 3000 players competing on the global leaderboard.

Speaking of competition, a big shout out to @CozyD, @Skye and @Li_tttt, who have been fighting for the top spot since almost day one. We are following your close dispute ;)

notes.title: Players have already reached Rank 20!!
notes.content:
It surprised us that with just 24h from launch, there are players above Rank 20 already! Nice job guys!

So we decided to update the game. Now, the first daily lock will happen only after Rank 3. This means that you can start playing the game with some good ammount of expressions before the first daily screen lock.
After Rank 3, you can keep playing one Rank per day for free.
But remember that you can remove this limitation at any time by buying a DLC that unlock the whole game at once. It costs only $0.99!

Support Indie Devs :)
